title: ZERO-MINUTES-1: run the loops on the Cloudflare tick Worker, not on Actions minutes (projected 232% of the free quota)
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** each tick; each deploy-workers run
**Done check:** file:ops/worker-merge-evidence.jsonl
**Status:** open

Measured 2026-11-13 (scripts/actions_budget.py): 2011 min used by day 13, projected 4641 of 2000. checks 1218 (958 in failed runs), lane 364, executor 156, deploy-workers 75, deploy-site 72. Done in this change: checks runs its three most-failing steps first (a failing PR stops in seconds); deploy-workers.mjs runs on Windows.

Already on the Worker (seed/worker/src: lane.js, sweeper.js, executor.js): green-PR merge, open-loop sweep, repo-access check, executor dispatch. Live blocker, measured in D1 sweeper_runs 2026-11-13 19:50: every repo answers `pulls 404`, so the Worker merges nothing: the GitHub App token cannot see the ultrastable org repos. Code to adopt the right installation is deployed (live matches 2377d31); the install itself is the owner's one click (NEEDS-YOU: Connect GitHub), identity-bound.

Left, in order: (1) after the App covers the org, probe: sweeper_runs.status = ok and a green PR merged by the Worker with no lane run; (2) Worker-native executor: tick calls the Workers AI code agent (codeagent.js), writes the change with the GitHub contents API and opens the PR, so executor.yml (156 min) becomes the fallback; probe: a PR whose provenance host is cloudflare-worker and no executor run in `gh run list`; (3) drop the workflow_run trigger of lane.yml once (1) holds for 7 days; (4) run checks' fast core (secret scan, size, workflow lint) in the Worker on PR webhook so drafts need no Actions run.
